name: std::multiset<Key,Compare,Allocator>::rbegin, std::multiset<Key,Compare,Allocator>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first element of the reversed multiset. It corresponds to the last element of the non-reversed multiset. If the multiset is empty, the returned iterator is equal to rend().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
Because both iterator and const_iterator are constant iterators (and may in fact be the same type), it is not possible to mutate the elements of the container through an iterator returned by any of these member functions.

The underlying iterator of the returned reverse iterator is the end iterator. Hence the returned iterator is invalidated if and when the end iterator is invalidated.

libc++ backports crbegin() to C++98 mode.
